objective: Complete durable audit coverage for business mutations with database-level atomic row-change events while preserving existing semantic application audit events and avoiding high-volume/noise amplification.
principles: critical business mutations are audited in the same PostgreSQL transaction as the business write
audit failure aborts the associated audited business mutation
automatic audit events never store full row payloads or sensitive field values
existing human-readable semantic audit events may coexist with automatic database row-change events
legacy actor provenance is never fabricated
high-volume replacement projections are audited at batch/import level rather than one event per replaced row
technical concurrency counters are excluded from business audit to avoid noisy event amplification

existing_semantic_application_audit.target: retain semantic events; database row-change event provides atomic baseline
retain one batch semantic event; do not row-audit consultation_log
retain semantic event; settings row-change is also audited atomically

automatic database audit on durable affected business tables
automatic audit on daily_snapshots and any durable affected business table

replaceable high-volume current inventory projection; batch import provenance is the durable audit unit
potentially high-volume personal lookup telemetry; existing date-cleanup batch event avoids event explosion
